name: netgraph
description: Diagnostics, completion, hover, go-to-definition, rename and formatting for netgraph inventory YAML.

netgraph.server.path.markdownDescription: The `netgraph` executable. Set this to an absolute path when netgraph is in a virtual environment VS Code does not activate.

netgraph.server.args.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to the executable. `--no-watch` turns off netgraph's own folder watching; `--log FILE` records what the server did.

netgraph.server.enable.description: Run the netgraph language server for YAML files.
